about: A self-hosted web app for tracking workouts, built around running, cycling and other GPS activities.

prs.title: Each workout in a zip upload gets its own type
prs.broken: Uploading a zip or a FitoTrack backup with the type left on auto gave every workout the type of the first one, so a ride after a run was saved as a run.
prs.changed: The type is now worked out for each workout in the upload.
prs.matters: People importing a batch of workouts get rides, runs and other activities saved correctly.
